nodes.name: secrets-template.yaml
nodes.summary: Kubernetes manifest template defining the trendzo-secrets Opaque Secret, supplemental Secrets, and a ConfigMap in the trendzo-production namespace; values must be base64-encoded before applying.
nodes.languageNotes: Multi-document YAML (--- separators) — kubectl applies each document as a separate K8s object.

nodes.name: service.yaml
nodes.summary: Kubernetes Service manifests exposing the Trendzo app: a ClusterIP load-balanced service (AWS NLB annotations, Prometheus scraping on /api/metrics) plus a headless service for direct pod access.
nodes.languageNotes: Multi-document YAML defining two Service objects in the trendzo-production namespace.

nodes.name: SOW_design_partner.md
nodes.summary: Design partner pilot Statement of Work template for ViralLab covering scope (Baseline Oracle, Predictive Scoring, Causal Uplift, Commerce Bridge), 2-4 week timeline, fees, and payment terms.

nodes.name: feature-scaler.pkl
nodes.summary: Python pickle binary containing a fitted feature scaler (e.g., StandardScaler) used to normalize feature vectors before XGBoost virality prediction.
nodes.languageNotes: Pickle (.pkl) binary; loaded by Python prediction service, not parseable as source.

nodes.name: xgboost-v6-scaler.pkl
nodes.summary: Pickled feature scaler paired with the XGBoost v6 virality model; restores the exact preprocessing transform applied during training.

nodes.name: xgboost-v7-scaler.pkl
nodes.summary: Pickled feature scaler paired with the XGBoost v7 virality model; applied to incoming feature vectors before prediction.

nodes.name: feature-names.json
nodes.summary: Ordered list of feature names expected by the legacy XGBoost prediction pipeline; the array order must align with the scaler and model column order.

nodes.name: holdout-video-ids.json
nodes.summary: Holdout set definition (description, created_at, total, tier_counts, video_ids) listing video IDs excluded from training so they can be used for unbiased evaluation of XGBoost models.

nodes.name: training-metrics.json
nodes.summary: Aggregated training and validation metrics snapshot for the XGBoost virality pipeline, surfacing run-level performance numbers consumed by the readiness/health dashboards.

nodes.name: xgboost-dps-model.json
nodes.summary: Serialized XGBoost model (single-line JSON booster dump) for the legacy DPS-style virality scorer.
nodes.languageNotes: Single minified JSON line encoding the full booster tree ensemble — large payload, opaque to humans.

nodes.name: xgboost-enhanced.json
nodes.summary: Serialized XGBoost booster JSON for an enhanced legacy virality variant, kept alongside the DPS model for comparison/fallback.

nodes.name: xgboost-v10-features.json
nodes.summary: Feature name list for the XGBoost v10 virality model; defines exact column order required by the v10 predict pipeline.

nodes.name: xgboost-v10-metadata.json
nodes.summary: Training metadata for XGBoost v10 (hyperparameters, dataset stats, evaluation metrics, feature importance) consumed by the model-card UI and integrity checks.

nodes.name: xgboost-v10-model.json
nodes.summary: Serialized XGBoost v10 booster (single-line JSON tree ensemble) loaded by the Python prediction service at inference time.

nodes.name: xgboost-v10-scaler.json
nodes.summary: JSON-serialized feature scaler parameters (mean/scale per feature) for XGBoost v10; portable alternative to the pickle scalers.

nodes.name: xgboost-v15-features.json
nodes.summary: Feature name list for XGBoost v15 (the current champion model per S9 backfill resume); column order must match the v15 scaler and model.

nodes.name: xgboost-v15-metadata.json
nodes.summary: Training metadata and headline metrics for XGBoost v15 (Spearman correlations, training dates, hyperparameters); v15 holds the current production baseline that v16-candidate failed to beat.

nodes.name: xgboost-v15-model.json
nodes.summary: Serialized XGBoost v15 booster JSON — the production-promoted model used by the prediction pipeline after S9 evaluation declined to promote v16.

nodes.name: xgboost-v15-scaler.json
nodes.summary: JSON feature scaler (mean/scale arrays plus feature names) paired with the XGBoost v15 booster; ensures inference uses the same normalization as training.

nodes.name: xgboost-v6-features.json
nodes.summary: Feature name list for XGBoost v6 (42 features after the fake-feature audit fix that moved xgboost-virality-ml into Phase 2 of the orchestrator).

nodes.name: xgboost-v6-metadata-baseline.json
nodes.summary: Baseline metadata snapshot for XGBoost v6 (pre-fix metrics, hyperparameters, training data summary); preserved for before/after comparison after the fake-feature remediation.

nodes.name: xgboost-v6-metadata.json
nodes.summary: Current XGBoost v6 training metadata (hyperparameters, feature importances, evaluation metrics) used by the readiness/health dashboards and model cards.

nodes.name: xgboost-v6-model.json
nodes.summary: Serialized XGBoost v6 booster JSON loaded by the Python prediction service for the v6 virality scorer.

nodes.name: xgboost-v7-features.json
nodes.summary: Feature name list for the XGBoost v7 virality model; required to align live feature vectors with the v7 booster's expected column order.

nodes.name: xgboost-v7-metadata.json
nodes.summary: Training metadata for XGBoost v7 (hyperparameters, dataset composition, evaluation metrics, feature importances) used by readiness and health surfaces.
